nativePort.gameIdentity: Japanese King's Field III / US King's Field II, SLUS-00255

modLoading.launch: Play starts the installed Verdite3 launcher. First launch compiles from the player's SLUS-00255 disc.
modLoading.removal: Disable a mod in the shared Mods tab while the game is closed. Lexeditor removes its deployed copy and restores the previous native enable flag and priority.
